correctness.rationale: For real r>0 and N>=1, increment Δ_N=a_r(N)-a_r(N-1)=P_{r,N}(1-int_0^1 R_{r,N}(t)dt), with P=Gamma(N+r+1)/(Gamma(r)Gamma(N+1)) r^r N^N/(N+r)^(N+r+1), R=(1+t/N)^N/(1+t/(N+r))^(N+r+1). Beta integral and source Lemma 2.2 yield identity. Ratio P_{N+1}/P_N=(1+1/N)^N((N+r)/(N+r+1))^(N+r+1)<1. R(t) in (0,1) and strictly increases in N because x log(1+t/x) has strictly negative second derivative and the additional logarithm derivative is positive. Thus positive H=1-int R strictly decreases, and Δ_{N+1}<Δ_N. This establishes strict ordinary discrete concavity for every integer n>=0, without extending to arbitrary cutoff or continuous index.
